source.note: Search summaries (skiresort, Kitzsteinhorn/Maiskogel): 24 lifts — 1 funicular, 1 aerial tramway (cable car), 6 gondolas, 1 combined gondola/chair installation, 6 chairlifts and 9 T-bar/platter lifts (other = funicular + combined installation); total capacity 44,045 persons/hour. Slopes 62.5 km: 30.5 km easy (49%), 23 km intermediate (37%), 9 km difficult (14%), plus 8.9 km of ski routes (https://www.skiresort.info/ski-resort/kitzsteinhornmaiskogel-kaprun/slope-offering/). 5 freeride lines and 4 snow parks.
Piste reference data — confirm at source. Only features Piste is confident about are set; everything else is unknown (null), not 'not offered'. Ski schools and rental shops operate at the bases

character: Salzburg province's glacier ski area above Kaprun, reaching 3,029 m and usually opening in October, with the town's Maiskogel linked to the glacier by gondola. It is known for its snow parks and marked freeride lines.
learning: Search summary: about half of the piste km are rated easy. Reference note: beginners usually start on the Maiskogel or the glacier plateau; confirm ski schools and lessons.
